summary: A legally consequential day with major regulatory rulings affecting retail and spirits sectors, plus strategic developments at Reliance. Market volatility continues with mixed earnings performance across sectors.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court rejects Pernod's plea to sell liquor in Delhi, citing criminal background concerns for the retailer.
Reliance evaluating strategic pathways for Jio; Ambani notes profit/loss not guaranteed amid market uncertainties.
Gold demand plummets 70% after sharp duty hike; fortnight demand falls to 7.5 tonnes from 25 tonnes year-ago.
Five new judges recommended for Supreme Court appointment; strengthens judiciary capacity amid pending case backlog.
Delhi HC rules Google liable for trademark infringement in keyword advertising; startup founders applaud landmark decision.
